The score blends 50/200-day trend, RSI, MACD, volume confirmation, 6/12-month momentum, distance from support, and volatility. Each risk setting changes the weights and the cash reserve. The weights are hand-designed and have not been validated as predictive. A score of at least 65 and a price above rising 50/200-day averages qualifies for a model allocation; other candidates remain on watch. Sizes favor lower volatility, respect per-position limits, and leave unused funds in cash. Fractional share estimates assume broker support and exclude fees. These are five research candidates, not a diversified whole portfolio. It is a screening signal—not a prediction or guarantee.
